modules.name: mobile_app_impersonation
modules.live_check: V3LUM_LIVE=1 tests/live/test_p2_g03_2.py, 2 passed (2026-11-26): domain:google.com with a synthetic Google org profile -> OK; Apple iTunes 'google' answered 44 apps (28 official App Store apps, 1 look-alike for review, 15 unrelated), Digital Asset Links google.com/youtube.com answered (38 official Android packages), Koodous NEEDS_KEY without any request (no token); a raw iTunes search for 'wikipedia' got Apple's empty-body 403 (intermittent refusal of this datacenter egress, handled as could-not-verify).

core_requests: ctx.wait(seconds) (bounded by the run deadline, cut by the kill switch) or a per-call wait_before for ctx.http: P346 c3 allows ONE same-request retry after an Apple 403 and the live checks suggest ~8 s of back-off; the core limiter applies a raised per-call min_interval only to the request after it, so today the retry waits only the provider pacing (>= 3.75 s)
URL fetchers of the LIGHT phase (P376/AR02) must refuse automatic downloads of .apk URLs (use mobile_app_impersonation.is_apk_url; P346 c8) - this batch records them only (rule mobile_app_apk_link)

P378 org_profile schema: document and validate the [[app_ids]] kinds apple_developer_id, apple_seller, apple_track_id, bundle_id, bundle_prefix, android_package, android_cert_sha256 (read by mobile_app_impersonation and apk_triage)

A seed-run API to read the case's results of other modules (e.g. apk_triage package + certificate SHA-256) so P346 could compare APKs inside the module; today the correlation rule mobile_app_apk_official_cert does it on the graph
Architect decision (P346 notes W3): sha256 input restricted to APK hashes with apk_triage provenance, to enable Koodous hash lookups (koodous_detail_url is implemented but unused)
notes: One PASSIVE module (P346) with three registry sources: apple.itunes_search (license, trusted; new provider 'apple', host itunes.apple.com, min_interval 3 s + token bucket 0.333/s, errorMessage marker), google_dal.statements (open; P008's existing provider and client: fetch_statements/normalize_cert_sha256 imported from v3lum/modules/domain_dns/digital_asset_links.py, no second client) and koodous.apks (key-terms, community; new provider 'koodous', key 'koodous' with env alias V3LUM_KOODOUS_TOKEN, quota scope key 15/day, throttling marker -> QUOTA). Module.terms = license, derived trust_tier = community, max_tlp AMBER, default_enabled True (candidate: under corporate the gate allows only the DAL source until licence_allow clears Apple and key_plans.koodous=business). f-droid.org is not declared (c4: F-Droid dropped). run_on='seeds' plus an in-module is_seed check (c1); company/keyword seeds outside org_profile brands need explicit -M (ScanOptions.include); non-org domains are SKIPPED not_applicable. Official = developer id / track id / seller name / exact bundle id of org_profile, or Android package + certificate in DAL/org_profile; a developer-entered org seller URL or bundle prefix with another seller stays a look-alike with a higher score (W4). Review list (look-alikes + unverified) LOW 'needs analyst review', confidence possible, capped at 20, pivots expand=False, never 'malicious'. Artwork/screenshots/previews never leave the parser. A bare 403 is retried once with the identical request (same UA/headers), then BLOCKED challenge 'could not verify'; challenge/geo pages are never retried. Google Play only as manual links (res.link + Module.manual_link). c4 apk_triage and c8 .apk links are covered by correlation rules in v3lum/correlations/p2_g03_2.py with graph fixtures. Health check: offline=False self-test (P008 client on example.com, plus one benign iTunes search when allowed). Koodous answers with a token are synthetic/doc-example fixtures (backlog: real fixture). No acceptance route file: the module makes no request on the golden inputs (example.com is not an org domain). Registry-contract and P327 lint failures seen during the run belong to other batches in progress (exploit_index, poc_index, msrc_patch_tuesday, github_email_pivot, gravatar, hibp_account, leakcheck_public, lunar_domain_exposure, xposedornot*, isc_dshield, leakix; lint: breach_leak/xposedornot.py). Tests: tests/modules/test_mobile_app_impersonation.py 45 passed; rule fixtures of both rules pass; registry contract green for mobile_app_impersonation; P327 lint clean on the module and the rule pack; ruff clean. Full offline suite: 17 failures, all in other batches' or core files mid-edit (test_ioc_extract x3, test_ransomfeed x7, test_leakix x2, test_typosquat x1, registry contract notices/registration of modules not yet created by other batches x2, multi_source_malicious rule fixtures x2), unchanged on re-run.
